scripts.verify: pnpm --workspace-root exec turbo run type-check test --filter=@hushvault/api... --filter=@hushvault/secrets-action
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run db:migrate:dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrations:list:dev: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --env dev
scripts.db:migrations:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --env production
